meta.title: Turn judgments into decisions
meta.description: Ordo is an open-source decision engine. Models like Jev tell you what is going on, and Ordo decides what to do about it. Rules have tests and versions, and you see which decisions a change moves before you make it.

hero.subtitle: Models tell you what is going on. Ordo decides what to do about it, and shows who a change affects first.
hero.shot_alt: Ordo Studio showing a loan approval ruleset as a flow

items.title: Models judge, rules decide
items.desc: Models like Jev read what a customer wrote. Whether to refund, and whether a person looks first, is written in rules anyone on the team can read.

items.title: See the impact first
items.desc: Before you move a threshold, see which decisions change and what they change to.

items.title: Live without a release
items.desc: Updated rules take effect right away. Your application code stays the same, with no redeploy.

impact.title: Every app that uses Jev has a 0.85 in it
impact.p1: A customer writes in, Jev decides it is a refund request, and anything above 0.85 is refunded automatically. That 0.85 usually sits in code nobody has looked at, and after a model update it means something else.
impact.p2: Once it lives in Ordo, someone proposes 0.80. Every test still passes. Ordo runs the old and new rules side by side and finds 18 cases that move from "agent checks" to "refund now". You decide before the change goes in.
impact.ai: Jev turns text into judgments. Ordo turns judgments into decisions.

studio.title: Rules your whole team can read
studio.desc: See the same rules as a flow or as a table. Business teams read the logic, run tests and request releases there. Engineers keep working in the code repository.

cta.title: Start from a ready-made example
cta.desc: Jev refund routing, credit approval, promo stacking and fraud scoring, already written. Copy one and change it to your own policy.

footer.desc: An open-source decision engine. Models give the judgment, Ordo decides what happens next, and you see what a change affects first.
